name: Spore compost
text: Dark, crumbly compost that smells of rain. Makes a tile Spore soil.

name: Glow dust
text: A pinch of faintly shining dust. Makes a tile Glow soil.

name: Bloom mulch
text: Soft mulch full of old petals. Makes a tile Bloom soil.

name: Verdure leaf mould
text: Rich, green leaf mould. Makes a tile Verdure soil.

name: Shimmer crystal dust
text: Fine crystal grit that glitters in the earth. Makes a tile Shimmer soil.

name: Spirit mist
text: Cool mist in a jar; it sinks into the ground. Makes a tile Spirit soil.

name: Garden loam
text: Plain, honest soil. Turns a tile back to plain ground.
